enum T_GATTS_READ_TYPE

GATTS client read type.

Values:

enumerator GATTS_READ_CLIENT_SUPPORTED_FEATURES

Read type for gatts_read to read Client Supported Features characteristic value. When receiving the read response, this read type will be sent to APP by read result callback. The structure of read result data is T_CLIENT_SUPPORTED_FEATURES.

enumerator GATTS_READ_DATABASE_HASH

Read type for gatts_read to read Database Hash characteristic value. When receiving the read response, this read type will be sent to APP by read result callback.

enum T_GATTS_WRTIE_TYPE

GATTS client write type.

Values:

enumerator GATTS_WRITE_SERVICE_CHANGED_IND_ENABLE

Response write type for gatts_client_set_service_changed_ind to enable CCCD.

enumerator GATTS_WRITE_SERVICE_CHANGED_IND_DISABLE

Response write type for gatts_client_set_service_changed_ind to disable CCCD.

enumerator GATTS_WRITE_CLIENT_SUPPORTED_FEATURES

Response write type for gatts_client_set_client_supported_features to write Client Supported Features characteristic value.

enum T_GATTS_NOTIF_IND_TYPE

GATTS client notification/indication receive type.

Values:

enumerator GATTS_SERVICE_CHANGED_INDICATE

Indication for Service Changed characteristic from remote device. When receiving this type, APP shall initiate discovery procedure.

enum T_GATTS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE

GATTS client callback type.

Values:

enumerator GATTS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_DISC_STATE

Discovery procedure state, done or pending.

enumerator GATTS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_READ_RESULT

Read request's result data, responded from server.

enumerator GATTS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_WRITE_RESULT

Write result, success or fail.

enumerator GATTS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_NOTIF_IND_RESULT

Notification or indication data received from server.

enumerator GATTS_CLIENT_CB_TYPE_INVALID

Invalid callback type, no practical usage.
